sn36.16:1.1: atha kho āyasmā ānando yena bhagavā tenupasaṅkami upasaṅkamitvā bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā ekamantaṃ nisīdi. ekamantaṃ nisinnaṃ kho āyasmantaṃ ānandaṃ bhagavā etadavoca
sn36.16:1.2: katamā nu kho ānanda vedanā katamo vedanāsamudayo katamo vedanānirodho katamā vedanānirodhagāminī paṭipadā
sn36.16:1.3: ko vedanāya assādo ko vedanāya ādīnavo kiṃ vedanāya nissaraṇanti.
sn36.16:1.4: bhagavaṃmūlakā no bhante dhammā bhagavaṃnettikā bhagavaṃpaṭisaraṇā sādhu bhante bhagavantaññeva paṭibhātu etassa bhāsitassa attho bhagavato sutvā bhikkhū dhāressantīti.
sn36.16:1.5: tenahi ānanda suṇohi sādhukaṃ manasikarohi bhāsissāmīti.
sn36.16:1.6: evaṃ bhanteti kho āyasmā ānando bhagavato paccassosi.
sn36.16:1.9: sukhā vedanā dukkhā vedanā adukkhamasukhā vedanā.
sn36.16:1.12: khīṇāsavassa bhikkhuno rāgo paṭippassaddho hoti doso paṭippassaddho hoti moho paṭippassaddho hotīti.
